world.description: Paddle a canoe down a cherry-blossom river through four seasons.

params.text: You reached the winter shrine. The river carried you through every season.

pagoda.description: A detailed twelve-meter East Asian pagoda with three to seven tapering stories, four-sided upturned eaves, balconies, timber framing, a stone base, and a gold finial spire.

torii-gate.description: Detailed Japanese torii gate with tapered vermilion pillars, black stone bases, layered collars, two crossbeams, an upswept top lintel, and a central gold-accented plaque.

waterfall.description: A detailed stepped rock waterfall with broad translucent cascades, a round stone-edged pool, foamy impact water, ripples, and scattered natural rocks, readable from every side.

waterColor.description: Color of the waterfall and pool water

intro.objective: Gather the 12 floating lanterns and reach the winter shrine.
intro.tagline: Paddle downstream through spring blossom, summer green, autumn fire and winter snow.
intro.title: Sakura River Journey

world.name: Sakura River Journey

rules.description: Chapter card: Spring — the blossom tunnel
Chapter card: Summer — the green reach
Chapter card: Autumn — maples under the pagoda
Chapter card: Winter — the snow shrine

then.text: Every lantern is lit. Paddle on to the shrine.
